title: Meshtastic Logistics Metadata Collector: radio, device and logistics-event metadata and KPIs for SME logistics
description:
Python software layer for a private Meshtastic LoRa mesh network used as a backup channel for critical logistics operations of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). It accompanies the manuscript Strengthening Economic Autonomy in Small and Medium-Sized Enterprise Logistics with Meshtastic Mesh Networks: Visual Analytics and Investment Appraisal and turns the model assumptions of that study into quantities that can be measured in a field pilot.

  • collector.py – gateway collector (USB/TCP or offline replay) that stores packet (L1), device (L2) and logistics-event (L3) metadata in a local SQLite database, works without Internet and keeps a store-and-forward outbox for ERP/TMS synchronisation;
  • logi_proto.py – 24-byte binary frame with CRC-16/CCITT for EVENT/ACCEPT/DONE/REJECT messages on PRIVATE_APP (port 256);
  • schema.sql – metadata store schema (L1–L4);
  • kpi.py – article indicators: channel utilization, flood overhead, position delivery ratio, age of information, actionability η, operational autonomy Aop, loss reduction Rloss;
  • make_replay.py, import_plan.py, run_demo.sh, tests/ – reproducible end-to-end run on synthetic data.

Status: prototype verified on synthetic data only (no radio hardware, no field measurements); tested with meshtastic-python 2.7.11.
